function.name: check_existing_patient
function.description: Look up a patient by phone number before creating a new record. Call this as soon as the caller's phone number has been collected, so returning callers can be offered an update instead of a duplicate registration.

phone_number.description: The caller's 10-digit U.S. phone number, in any format (digits, dashes, spaces all accepted).

function.name: create_patient
function.description: Create a new patient registration record. Only call this after reading back all collected information and receiving explicit confirmation from the caller. The backend re-validates every field; if it returns success:false, re-prompt the caller for exactly the field named in the response.

first_name.description: Patient's first name. Letters, hyphens, and apostrophes only.

last_name.description: Patient's last name. Letters, hyphens, and apostrophes only.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be in the future.

sex.description: Sex on file, exactly one of the enum values.

preferred_language.description: Optional preferred language, defaults to English.

emergency_contact_phone.description: Optional emergency contact 10-digit U.S. phone number.

function.name: update_patient
function.description: Update an existing patient record, found via check_existing_patient. Only include fields the caller actually wants changed; omit everything else.

patient_id.description: The existing patient's ID, from check_existing_patient's response.
